status: Supplemental reference frozen before inspecting extended held-out retrieval scores; separate from the nine primary SQLite policies.
data: Identical prepared NoMIRACL query sets, integrity amendment, and nested 10000/100000 document pools used by the primary study.
analysis: Default language analyzers, including their native stopwords and token graphs; Swahili uses StandardAnalyzer. Configured split languages are oracle hints.
query: QueryBuilder SHOULD term queries in body and title, title boost 2; explicitly quoted complete inputs use phrase queries. No tuning on held-out results.
ranking: BM25Similarity k1=1.2 b=0.75, default per-field collection statistics and compressed norms; score descending then deterministic document hash order.
metrics: Shared judgment-aware nDCG@10, Recall@100, MRR@10 and development-only no-known-positive acceptance calibration. Conditional paired intervals versus the same baseline query IDs.
qualification: Default Lucene analyzer plus ranker reference, not a controlled isolated tokenizer comparison or raw-score parity with SQLite. Title boost multiplies a per-field score instead of a column-weighted term frequency; repeated terms follow Lucene QueryBuilder semantics rather than the primary unique-term OR policy.
stopwordExport: Read default lexical stopword sets through getDefaultStopSet where available; missing lexical-set APIs are explicitly unsupported, not inferred from POS filters. Exported data stays outside Git.
